computation_method: Regex-heuristic computation modeled on src/god-agent/cli/style/lanham-prose-analyzer.ts (Tier 1), parallel to the §1.4 baseline computation. Same exclusion rules: \cite, \footnote (balanced-brace), \inlinenote (balanced-brace), \hl (unwrap), \textit/\emph/\textbf (unwrap), \gk/\textgreek (drop), \section/\subsection (drop), $...$ math (drop), TikZ environment (drop). Per MEMORY.md 2026-04-16: current Tier 1 calibration has hit a regex ceiling; this profile is analyst-computed with explicit assumptions documented per axis. Deltas vs §1.4 baseline tagged per Plan §9.3.1 (ALIGNED ±0.10, DRIFT-TOWARD/AWAY ±0.10-0.20, INVERSE beyond label boundary).

nounVerb.label: noun-style-leaning
nounVerb.rationale_short: Nominalization density 60.36/1000 is lower than §1.4's 78.01/1000 — consistent with introduction's softer architectural commitment and slightly more verb-active framing. Be-verb rate 1.22/sentence is also lower than §1.4's 1.82/sentence (the introduction does less 'X is Y' philosophical-definitional work). Prep-phrase rate 4.40/sentence is comparable to §1.4 (4.09). The score 0.58 places §1.0 on the noun-style side of neutral but less aggressively than §1.4. Confidence 0.74: as in §1.4, Greek/German nominal vocabulary (phantasia, kinēsis, energeia, phantasma, phantasmata, doxa, aisthēsis, noesis) inflates this count; the soft drift toward verb-style is real but modest.
nounVerb.comparison_to_gold_set_mean: -0.01 below gold-set mean (0.590) — i.e., nearly at population mean

parataxisHypotaxis.label: hypotactic
parataxisHypotaxis.rationale_short: Subordinator-to-coordinator ratio of 0.688 is somewhat hypotactic but below §1.4's 0.839. Coordinator count (189) outpaces subordinator count (130), reflecting the introduction's prose-flow strategy: long sentences are built by stacking coordinated clauses (e.g., the methodology paragraph's serial 'and...and...and' chain at lines 41 and 64). Score 0.55 is on the hypotactic side of neutral but markedly less embedded than §1.4. The methodology section's 'this chapter proceeds as follows' construction (line 68) is a paratactic-coordinated catalog rather than a hypotactically-embedded analysis. Confidence 0.75.
parataxisHypotaxis.comparison_to_gold_set_mean: +0.18 above gold-set mean (0.372). Still substantially hypotactic for academic prose; difference vs §1.4 is within ±0.10.

periodicRunning.label: running-with-periodic-elements
periodicRunning.rationale_short: Periodic candidate rate 0.256 is meaningfully lower than §1.4's 0.414. The introduction front-loads less subordinate/participial material than the gold-standard architectural chapter; it more often opens with the grammatical subject ('Aristotle defines...', 'Phantasia, therefore, functions...', 'White elucidates...', 'Aristotle gives us three factors'). Where §1.4 cultivates periodic suspension as a rhetorical signature, §1.0 runs more openly. Average sentence length is comparable (31.08 vs 32.72), but distribution of within-sentence weight is more even-handed. Score 0.36 = slightly running of neutral, on the same side as the gold set mean. This matches the predicted DRIFT direction in §1.4's baseline note ('introductions often run rather than periodic'). Confidence 0.62.
periodicRunning.comparison_to_gold_set_mean: +0.01 above gold-set mean (0.349) — almost exactly at population mean; appropriate for an accessibility-oriented introduction.

voice.label: predominantly-active

sub_metrics.active_marker: author-prominent citations dominant (Aristotle defines, Aristotle describes, Aristotle states, White elucidates, Frede argues, O'Gorman remarks)

voice.rationale_short: Passive rate 0.302/sentence is slightly higher than §1.4's 0.238/sentence, but the absolute passive count (39 in 129 sentences) is comparable in proportion. The introduction's marginally more passive surface reflects two features: (1) the 'phantasia is presented in De Anima as being fundamental' passive at line 11 and similar constructions used when characterising scholarly readings; (2) the methodology's 'these are traced in the downstream sections' construction at line 45. The 0.34 score is still on the active side of neutral, within the §1.4 baseline window. Author-prominent citation is the dominant frame throughout. Confidence 0.72.
voice.comparison_to_gold_set_mean: -0.03 below gold-set mean (0.372) — appropriately active for author-prominent academic prose.

sub_metrics.Greek_term_density: high (phantasia x77, kinēsis x9, aisthēsis x4, noesis x2, doxa x4, energeia ateles x2, phantasma/phantasmata throughout; the Greek-with-translation pattern is sustained)

register.rationale_short: Latinate-proxy ratio 0.193 is meaningfully lower than §1.4's 0.220, and the section omits signature transitions like 'specifically' and 'indeed' entirely (zero occurrences each, where §1.4 has 4 and 10 respectively). The introduction's register is decidedly academic-Latinate but markedly less so than §1.4 — consistent with the introductory function (accessibility before density). Greek-with-gloss is sustained (phantasia/aisthēsis/noesis/doxa). German-philosophical vocabulary is largely absent in this section (cf. §1.4's Befindlichkeit/Stimmung/Geworfenheit cluster). The chapter is Heidegger-light by metadata's own acknowledgment. Score 0.64 places §1.0 in the high-formal range but below the gold-standard mark. Confidence 0.79.
register.comparison_to_gold_set_mean: +0.07 above gold-set mean (0.574). The DRIFT-TOWARD prediction in §1.4's baseline note is partially borne out: §1.0 register is meaningfully below §1.4's, though it remains within the ALIGNED window (within ±0.10). The German-vocabulary absence is the largest single contributor to the dip. Increasing Heidegger-vocabulary integration (per the user's note that §1.0 'frames the soul's rhetorical nature' with reference to a forthcoming chapter) would close this gap.

opacity.rationale_short: Opacity is the axis Tier 1 is weakest on (MEMORY.md notes ceiling 0.193). The introduction's transparency markers: explicit 'I will argue', 'I believe', 'I think', 'I will' first-person interpretive flagging (the 'first-personal-voice' is more prominent in this section than in §1.4); the methodology subsection's full transparency about the actualization-chain being 'my interpretive construction' (lines 43, 47); the \hl markers and \inlinenote markers as user-acknowledged self-edits. Meta-linguistic transition density 0.116/sentence is below §1.4's 0.208/sentence, but absolute transparency is higher because of denser first-person flagging in the methodology subsection. Alliteration density 0.938/sentence is below §1.4's 1.422, suggesting less prose-decorative density (running prose has fewer adjacent-alliterative bursts than periodic). Score 0.27 — more transparent than §1.4. Confidence 0.55.
opacity.comparison_to_gold_set_mean: +0.08 above gold-set mean (0.193). Still meaningfully transparent for academic prose; the introduction's pedagogical function is consistent with this (first-person 'I will argue' is appropriate at the introduction's threshold).

tacit_patterns.rationale_short: The section's most distinctive tacit pattern is ISOCOLON, deployed for cataloging: the four temporal events T_1-T_4, the actualization-chain procession $A_0$-$A_4$, the chapter-proceeds-as-follows catalog. Where §1.4 uses isocolon to articulate the five-fold conclusion, §1.0 uses isocolon to introduce the chain architecture pedagogically. POLYPTOTON is high — the introduction is the canonical site where the user introduces the phantasia/phantasma/phantasmata cluster and prepares the reader for its etymological variations throughout the dissertation. ANTITHESIS appears (phantasia between aisthēsis and noesis, body and soul, sensation and thought) but is less aggressively cultivated than §1.4. The first-person 'I will argue' / 'I believe' / 'I think' interpretive-voice pattern is more frequent here than in §1.4 — appropriate for an introduction's threshold function.

first_person_interpretive_flag_density.comparison_to_diss04: §1.4 has higher first-person flag count overall but distributed differently; §1.0 front-loads first-person ownership of architectural commitments in the methodology subsection (lines 41-47), where §1.4 distributes them across nine subsections.

framing_of_phantasia.primary_framing_in_intro: temporal-narrative-synthesizing capacity that 'creates a continuous narrative of experience, enabling humans to navigate their reality cohesively in time' (line 17)
framing_of_phantasia.secondary_framing: rhetorical-ontological: 'the kinetic and affective capacity that generates a continuous, affectively charged narrative of experience' (line 36)
framing_of_phantasia.tertiary_framing: soul's temporal medium: 'the faculty through which motion becomes phantasmata, and phantasmata become the material of thought' (line 32)
framing_of_phantasia.consistency_with_sections_1_1_to_1_4: PARTIAL. §1.0 frames phantasia as primarily temporal-narrative-synthesizing; §§1.1-1.4 develop the chain such that phantasia is one node (A_3 in the new numbering, the M_2→A_3 motion in the migrated convention) and not the whole-chain temporal medium. The introduction's framing is broader than §§1.1-1.4's delivery, which puts phantasia at the central organ producing the phantasma proper but not as the temporal medium of the whole chain. The mismatch is documented in detail in phase2-claims.md DISS-00-C012 / DISS-00-C014 and tagged as `inconsistent-with` to §1.3's positioning.
